title: Real-Time Log Analytics & Observability Platform
description: Built a distributed observability platform that ingests, processes, indexes, and visualizes streaming application logs in real time using Apache Kafka, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Lucene, and Grafana.

title: PulseDrop - Minimal Real-Time Incident Reporting System

title: VoltStream
